description: Answer 'can a party of N stay from DATE for N nights?'. Returns a verdict (bookable yes/no), the reason when no, the room COMBINATIONS that house the party, and the booking URL. Applies the house rules for you: the earliest arrival date (today or tomorrow, depending on the same-day cut-off), and a stay needs the same rooms free on every night. A party too large for one room is NOT a refusal — the house is sold as several rooms. Prefer this over reading the raw calendar.

nights.description: Number of nights. Check-out is check_in + nights.

name: check_room_availability

explanation.description: A sentence you can relay to the guest.

options.description: Room combinations that house the party, each priced in its rate plans (VAT included).

reason.description: available · too_soon · too_far · invalid_date · not_bookable · party_exceeds_house · no_room_free_for_whole_stay
